{{Short description|Type of uniform tiling in geometry}}
{{Uniform hyperbolic tiles db|Uniform hyperbolic tiling stat table|Ui33_s}}
In [[geometry]], the '''snub infinite-order triangular tiling''' is a [[uniform tilings in hyperbolic plane|uniform tiling]] of the [[hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic plane]] with a [[Schläfli symbol]] of s{3,∞}.
